title: Kailing
text:
Hi! I’m Kailing, a graduate student at Cornell University.
Here are a few things about me:

I study Animal Science.
I am interested in genetics and genomics.
I am learning R, Python, and data science.
I enjoy hiking and exploring new places.



I am especially interested in using computational and quantitative approaches to understand biological data.
